title: Breaking Noise Shortcuts in Self-Supervised Learning Via Noise-Aligned View Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25335v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is increasingly applied to scientific imaging domains, such as microscopy, where labels are scarce but noisy data is abundant. These domains exhibit significant signal-dependent noise, which can create a representational shortcut: since both augmented views derive from the same noisy image, the encoder can boost view agreement by also encoding noise patterns rather than semantic content. To enable noise-robust representation learning without knowledge of underlying noise models, we introduce Self-Aligned Noise Augmentation (SEANA), a drop-in module that generates noise-aware SSL views. SEANA learns an invertible variance-stabilizing transform (VST) from noisy data, then estimates the clean signal and resamples independent noise in learned VST space, requiring no clean targets, no dataset-specific denoiser training or use at inference, and no changes to the SSL objective or encoder. On CIFAR-10 and ImageNe

translated_title: 通过噪声对齐的视图生成打破自监督学习中的噪声捷径
translated_abstract: 自监督学习（SSL）越来越多地应用于科学成像领域，例如显微镜成像，在这些领域中标签稀缺而含噪数据丰富。这些领域存在显著的信号依赖性噪声，这可能形成一种表征捷径：由于两个增强视图都源自同一张含噪图像，编码器可以通过同时编码噪声模式而非语义内容来提升视图一致性。为了在不掌握底层噪声模型的前提下实现噪声鲁棒的表征学习，我们提出了自对齐噪声增强（Self-Aligned Noise Augmentation, SEANA），这是一个即插即用模块，用于生成噪声感知的SSL视图。SEANA从含噪数据中学习一个可逆的方差稳定变换（VST），然后估计干净信号并在学习到的VST空间中重新采样独立噪声，整个过程无需干净目标数据、无需针对特定数据集训练去噪器或在推理时使用去噪器，也无需更改SSL目标函数或编码器。在CIFAR-10和ImageNe[t]……（原文摘要被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SEANA即插即用模块，通过从含噪数据中学习可逆方差稳定变换并重新采样独立噪声来生成噪声感知的自监督学习视图，从而打破噪声捷径，在无需噪声模型知识、干净数据和去噪器的情况下实现噪声鲁棒的表征学习。
en_tdlr: SEANA is a drop-in module that learns an invertible variance-stabilizing transform from noisy data to estimate the clean signal and resample independent noise, generating noise-aware SSL views that break noise shortcuts and enable noise-robust representation learning without knowledge of noise models, clean targets, or denoiser training.
